build_data2vec_classification_model: build a Data2VecImageClassificationModel from a pretrained checkpoint config with num classes and mixup settings
load_model_weights_from_checkpoint: load pretrained model weights from a checkpoint state dict into the Data2Vec model
forward_image_classification: run forward pass on image tensors through the Data2Vec model to get classification logits
configure_data2vec_classification: create a Data2VecImageClassificationConfig dataclass with model path, mixup, cutmix, and label smoothing params
review_data2vec_forward_pass: review the Data2VecImageClassificationModel forward method that applies mixup, extracts features, and computes cross entropy loss
